response.justification: Bogdan has over 12 years of software engineering experience, which meets the baseline seniority requirements, and has built complex, low-latency web and microservice architectures. However, his background is primarily in full-stack web development, testing frameworks, and GIS platforms. He lacks the required domain expertise in hardware-software co-design, SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, and AI accelerator workload optimization, making him fundamentally mismatched for this specialized hardware performance role.
strengths: Meets the baseline seniority requirement with a BS in Computer Science and over 12 years of technical experience.
Proven ability to build low-latency, high-throughput microservices using asynchronous I/O and DLang.
Strong foundational software engineering practices, including TDD, CI/CD, and system architecture design.
concerns: Complete lack of experience with SoC and IP modeling, which is a primary requirement for the role.
No background in hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or SIMD/MIMD systems.
Missing essential expertise in deep neural network training and inference workload optimization.
